book.name: Yohana
book.title: Amangʼana amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Yohana

content: Mariamu aramuhaka Yeesu amaguta
Hano zyasaagiri siku isaasabha kuhika Enyaangi yo Okuhiita, Yeesu akahika kweeki Betania, mumugye guno yamuryooriri Razaro okurwa mubhaku.
Ambe, abhaatu bha ahagiro hayo bhakamuginihya. Marita akamuhokeerya Yeesu ebhyaakurya, na Razaro yaari owumwe wa bhano bhakarya hamwe na Yeesu.

Kyaamwe, Mariamu akagega amaguta go omuruumbaaso gano gano obhuguri bhukuru bhukongʼu, akamuhaka Yeesu kumaguru, akamutarikya ne eziinzweeri zyaaye. Enyuumba yoosi ekiizura obhuraangaasiro bhuzomu bhwa amaguta go omuruumbaaso.
Nawe owumwe wa abhaanabheega bhaaye eriina ryaaye Yuuda Isikariyoti, wuno niwe araamurye omukoonyo Yeesu, akabhuga,
“Kwaki amaguta gayo gataaguriibhwe eziidinaari magana atatu (300)
no okuhaabhwa abhataka?”

Yuuda ataagaambiri ego kwe ekigirirye kyo okubharorera ebhigoongi abhataka, nawe kwe ekigirirye yaari mwiibhi. Ewe niwe yaari akubhiika esakwa ye eziimbirya. Yaari ariibha eziimbirya zino zikatuurwa musakwa yiyo.
Ambe, Yeesu akamukyoora Yuuda, “Mutamunyaakya omukari wuno, mumutige, abhiikiri amaguta gayo kwiiguru yo orusiku runo bharaambiike.
Abhataka bhari hamwe neemwe eziisiku zyoosi, nawe enye nitakubha hamwe neemwe eziisiku zyoosi.”
Abhakaangati bha Abhayahudi bharakomya enzira yo okumwiita Razaro
Ambe, Abhayahudi bhaaru bhakiigwa kubha Yeesu yaari ahagiro hayo, bhakagya kumurora etari ewe omweene, nawe kweeki kumurora Razaro, wuno Yeesu akamuryoora okurwa mubhaku.
Ambe, abhakuru bha abhaseengeri bhakataanga kukomya enzira yo okumwiita Razaro woosi,
kwo okubha Abhayahudi bhaaru bhakabhatiga abhakaangati bhaabhu, bhakamwiikirirya Yeesu, kutuukana na amangʼana go okuryooka kwa Razaro.
Yeesu arasuungʼaanwa Yerusaremu kya Masiya
Tabhoori yaho, esaango ekuru ya abhaatu bhano bhakaaza kuginiha Enyaangi yo Okuhiita, bhakiigwa kubha Yeesu ari munzira araaza Yerusaremu.
Ambe, bhakagega amatu ge emiteende, bhakagya kumusuungʼaana Yeesu. Bhakatiirya eriiraka bhakubhuga,

content.text: Atweerwe ebhite wuno akuuza kuriina ryo Omukuru!

content: Ambe, Yeesu akabhona etikiri, akatiira, akiikara kyeego ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru,
Eriibhaga riyo, abhaanabheega bha Yeesu bhataamenyiri engʼana yino ni ngʼanaki. Nawe hano Yeesu yaryookiri, bhakahiita kubha gayo gakaamirwe na niigo bhamukoreeri.
Abhaatu bhano bhaari na Yeesu hano yamubhirikiiri Razaro okurwa mumbiihira no okumuryoora okurwa mubhaku, bhakageenderera kunyaragania amangʼana gayo.
Ambe, abhaatu bhaaru bhaari bhiigwiiri amangʼana ge ekitiika kino Yeesu yakoriri, nikyo ekigirye bhakagya kumusuungʼaana.
Nawe Abhafarisayo bhakiibhuurya, “Murarora? Tutakunagya kukora kyokyoosi! Rora, abhaatu bhoosi bharamutuniirira ewe.”
Yeesu arakeerenia iguru yo oruku rwaaye
Haari na abhaatu bhano bhatari Abhayahudi gati wa abhaatu bhano bhakagya Yerusaremu kumuseengera Taatabhugya mu Nyaangi yo Okuhiita.
Ambe, abhaatu bhayo bhakagya ku Firipo wuno yarwiiri Betisaida mukyaaro kya Gariraaya, bhakamusabha, “Omukuru, turasabha turorane na Yeesu.”
Firipo akagya kumubhuurira Andurea amangʼana gayo, kyaamwe bhoosi bhabhiri bhakagya ku Yeesu kumubhuurira.
Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Eriibhaga rihikiri rya Taatabhugya okweerekya obhuguungo bhwe eheene bhwo Omwaana wo Omuutu.
Ndabhabhuurira obhuheene, eraabhe embibho ye engano ekyaari kukuundikirwa mumarobha no okukwa, etakutura kumera. Nawe eraabhe erakwa, eramera no okwiibhura emisumo myaaru.

Omuutu wowoosi wuno akuseega obhwiikari bhwaaye omweene, arabhubhurya, nawe omuutu wowoosi wuno akubhiihirirwa obhwiikari bhwaaye mukyaaro kino, wuyo arabhuriibha obhuhoru bhwaaye, okubha bhubhe bhwa kirakeego.
Omuutu wowoosi wuno akunihokeerya enye, ereenderwa anituniirire. Kweeki hohoosi hano nikubha, hayo niho omuhokya waane araabheho. Taata aramusuuka omuutu wowoosi wuno akunihokeerya enye.

“Bhoono nitaangiri kuhoobha bhukongʼu mukoro yaane. Mbe, nigaambeki? Nibhuge, ‘Ee Taata, ndakusabha onituurye mwiibhaga rino rye enyaako?’ Zeyi, nitakunagya kusabha ego, kwo okubha niiziri mukyaaro kino okubha nibhone enyaako yiyo.
Ee Taata Taatabhugya, okuundukure obhuguungo bhwe eriina ryaazo.” Niho, eriiraka rikagaamba okurwa mwiisaaro, “Nibhukuundukwiiri, kweeki ndageenderera okubhukuundukura.”
Esaango ya abhaatu bhano bhaari harya, hano bhakiigwa eriiraka okurwa mwiisaaro, abhaandi bhakabhuga kubha, orukubha rubharukiri, na abhaandi bhakabhuga kubha, maraika yaari akeereenie neewe.
Nawe, Yeesu akabhabhuurira abhaatu bharya, “Eriiraka rino mwaari mukwiigwa ritaari kwiiguru waane, nawe ryaari kwiiguru weenyu.
Bhoono, rihikiri eriibhaga rya Taatabhugya okutinira ekiina ekyaaro kino. Na rihikiri eriibhaga ryo okumuheebha Seetaani omukaangati we ekyaaro kino.
Hano enye ndaanuungwe iguru kumusaraba, ndabharuta bhoosi okubha bhiize kweenye.”
Yeesu akabhuga ego, okweerekya kyeego araakwe.
Ambe, esaango ya abhaatu bhakamukyoora Yeesu, “Tusomiri mu Makaamo Amahoreeru kubha, Masiya arabha muhoru kirakeego.
Ambe, kwaki orabhuga kubha, Omwaana wo Omuutu areenderwa kunuungwa iguru? Mbe, Omwaana wo Omuutu ni weewi?”

Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Obhweero bhurabha hamwe na neemwe kwe eriibhaga iguhi ego. Mugeenderere kugeenda mubhweero bhuno eriibhaga bhuriho, okubha ekiirima kitaaza okubhahiza, kwo okubha omuutu wuno akugeenda mukiirima atahamenyiri hano akugya.

Mutuure obhwiikirirya bhweenyu kubhweero bhuyo eriibhaga rino obhweero bhukyaari bhuriho, okubha mubhe abhaana bho obhweero.” Hano Yeesu yamariri kugaamba gayo, akatiga esaango yirya, akagya okwiibhisa.
Abhayahudi bhaaru bharaanga okumwiikirirya Yeesu
Yiingabha Yeesu akakora ebhitiika bhyaaru embere waabhu, nawe abhaatu bhaaru bhataamwiikiriirye.
Gaari ego okubha gakuunaane amangʼana gano omurooti Isaya yabhugiri,

content.text: “Omukuru, ni weewi wuno yiikiriirye amangʼana geetu?
Kweeki, Omukuru amukuundukuriirye weewi amanaga gaaye?”

content: Kweego bhataanagirye kwiikirirya, kwe ekigirirye Taatabhugya akagaamba kweeki kuhitira ku Isaya,

content.text: no okukora eziikoro zyaabhu zibhe kongʼu,

content: Isaya akagaamba gayo kwo okubha akarora obhuguungo bhwa Yeesu no okugaamba amangʼana gaaye.

Naabhe ego, abhakaangati bhaaru bha Abhayahudi bhakamwiikirirya Yeesu, nawe bhataagaambiri kubhweero bhamwiikiriirye, kwe ekigirirye bhaari bharoobhoha okuheebhwa na Abhafarisayo munyuumba ye esaango.
Abhakaangati bhayo, bhakaseega bhukongʼu okukumibhwa na abhaatu, kukira okukumibhwa na Taatabhugya.
Abhaatu bharatinirwa ekiina kwa amangʼanagano Yeesu yagaambiri
Ambe, Yeesu akagaamba kwiiraka ikuru, “Omuutu wuno akuniikirirya enye, atakuniikirirya enye omweene ego, nawe aramwiikirirya na wuno antumiri.
Hano anduuzi enye, amuruuzi na wuno antumiri.
Enye niiziri mukyaaro kino kyo obhweero, okubha abhaatu bhano bhakuniikirirya bhatige kubha mukiirima.
“Omuutu wowoosi wuno akwiitegeerera amangʼana gaane, nawe atakugagwaata, enye nitakumutinira ekiina, kwe ekigirirye nitiiziri mukyaaro kino kubhatinira ekiina abhaatu, nawe nikaaza kubhatuurya.
Naabhe ego, omuutu wowoosi wuno akunianga enye hamwe na amangʼana gaane, araaza okutinirwa ekiina. Amangʼana gano nigaambiri nigo gano gakuuza okumutinira ekiina kurusiku rwo obhuteero.
Nitagaambiri amangʼana gayo kwo obhuturo bhwaane omweene, nawe Taata wuno antumiri, niwe wuno aniswaagirye go okugaamba, na kyeego ndaagaambe.
Kweeki, nimenyiri kubha obhuswaagyo bhwaaye bhurabhaha abhaatu obhuhoru bhwa kirakeego. Niho, enye nikugaamba omweene ego gano Taata aniswaagirye okugaamba.”
